## MGIT–EEE Student Participation and Research Presentation at ICPS-2025, IIT Hyderabad

News Date : 09 Dec 2025News ReportThe Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (Autonomous), Hyderabad, facilitated the participation of B.Tech VII-Semester EEE students in theInternational Conference on Power Systems (ICPS-2025)organized by theIndian Institute of Technology Hyderabadon09 December 2025.The students attended the conference to gain valuable academic exposure and to learn from expert presentations across diverse domains of power systems research. Their participation contributed significantly to research-oriented learning, professional development, and awareness of contemporary advancements in power systems engineering.As part of this academic engagement, ajoint research paper titled“Short-Term Load Forecasting for Energy and Cost Savings: A Case Study”was successfullyaccepted and presented at ICPS-2025. The paper was presented on09 December 2025byMr. T. Praneeth (Reg. No. 22261A0237), along withMr. Gajangi Arun Kumar, Assistant Professor, andDr. P. Ram Kishore Kumar Reddy, Professor & Head, Department of EEE, MGIT, in collaboration withDr. Yemula Pradeep Kumar, Associate Professor, Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Hyderabad.This achievement reflects the strong academic and research collaboration betweenMGIT and IIT Hyderabadand highlights a productive research outcome of the partnership, reinforcing MGIT–EEE’s commitment to promoting quality research, student involvement, and collaborative academic excellence.

The students attended the conference to gain valuable academic exposure and to learn from expert presentations across diverse domains of power systems research. Their participation contributed significantly to research-oriented learning, professional development, and awareness of contemporary advancements in power systems engineering.

Ram Kishore Kumar Reddy, Professor & Head, Department of EEE, MGIT, in collaboration withDr. Yemula Pradeep Kumar, Associate Professor, Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Hyderabad.
This achievement reflects the strong academic and research collaboration betweenMGIT and IIT Hyderabadand highlights a productive research outcome of the partnership, reinforcing MGIT–EEE’s commitment to promoting quality research, student involvement, and collaborative academic excellence.
